europe_now.title: Spain Train Crash Aftermath
europe_now.summary: Following a deadly railway disaster in Spain, officials and reports continue to examine the systemic failures and infrastructure issues behind the high-speed rail network. Families and the public mourn the victims, which include notable figures, while debates intensify over accountability.

europe_now.title: Paris Suburb Shooting Investigation
europe_now.summary: French prosecutors report that the suspect in a Paris suburb shooting deliberately targeted individuals of Muslim or African appearance. The attack has heightened security concerns and sparked broader discussions across France regarding extremist right-wing ideologies.

top_stories.title: EU and Canada Enhance Bilateral Engagement
top_stories.summary: European and Canadian leaders met at a summit in Montreal to discuss shared strategic challenges and economic diversification. Discussions centered on navigating relations with global powers while strengthening bilateral ties.

top_stories.title: European Central Bank Leadership Transition
top_stories.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde has stepped down from her position to speak out freely on key matters. Analysts and policymakers are actively discussing potential front-runners to succeed her at the central bank.
